artworks.label: Tufted Heliconia
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for toucan-loom. One compact tropical heliconia flowering sprig made entirely of exquisitely tufted and twisted wool yarn. A graceful dark-teal stem with two small curved deep-teal leaves and four alternating substantial lobster-claw-shaped orange/ochre bracts edged in warm gold. Ivory tiny flower tips, clear asymmetrical botanical silhouette, richly tactile loopstitch veins and dense fine-cut-pile tufts. Refined crafted textile art, soft warm side lighting, restrained dark-indigo/teal/golden-yellow/muted-orange palette matching an elegant woven toucan collection. No bird, feather, fabric panel, pot or ground. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
